AppliedTactic:
have : ConvergesTo (x + y) (a + b) := by
      -- ⭐️ このとき任意の ε > 0に対して
      intro ε εpos
      -- ⭐️ n₁, n₂ ∈ ℕ があって、
      -- ⭐️ n ≥ n₁ → |x_n - a| < ε / 2
      -- ⭐️ n ≥ n₂ → |y_n - b| < ε / 2 となる。
      let ⟨n₁,h1⟩ := convxa (ε / 2) (by apply half_pos εpos)
      let ⟨n₂,h2⟩ := convyb (ε / 2) (by apply half_pos εpos)
      -- ⭐️ n₁, n₂の大きいほうをn₀とすれば、
      let n₀ := max n₁ n₂
      -- ⭐️ n ≥ n₀ のとき
      have : ∀ n ≥ n₀, |(x n + y n) - (a + b)| < ε := by
        intro n ngen₀
        calc
          |x n + y n - (a + b)| ≤ |x n - a| + |y n - b| := by
            rw [add_sub_add_comm]
            apply abs_add
          _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by
            have : n₀ ≥ max n₁ n₂ := Nat.le_refl (max n₁ n₂)
            apply add_lt_add (h1 n (le_trans (le_of_max_le_left this) ngen₀)) (h2 n (le_trans (le_of_max_le_right this) ngen₀))
          _ = ε := add_halves ε
      -- ⭐️となり、
      exact ⟨n₀, this ⟩

add_halves : This theorem asserts that in a linear ordered semifield, the sum of half of any element and half of the same element equals the original element itself.

le_refl : This theorem confirms that in a preorder, any element is related to itself under the less than or equal relation.
le_of_max_le_right : If the maximum of two elements is less than or equal to a third element, then the second element is also less than or equal to that third element.
add_sub_add_comm : In a subtraction commutative monoid, the sum of two elements minus the sum of two other elements equals the first element minus the third plus the second element minus the fourth.
